lines.t: I sit here in the night, but I see the light of your love
And I'm waiting for you until you take me away
I know your promise is true, oh, I long to be with you
Oh Lord, I'm waiting for you
Until you come one day
Oh, I'm waiting for you till you take me away
I'll be late, faithful
I'll stay awake and still I'll see your face
Hear your voice call my name
I'll be waiting, waiting for you
You bring light to the darkest places
You shine so bright
Even in the shadows
Even in the night
And I look forward to seeing you
And as I wait
I'll remain faithful to you
I'll remain true
And until you call me
Lord, I'll be waiting, waiting for you
Oh, I'll wait until you, till you take me away
I'll remain faithful, I'll stay awake in the dim light
I see your face, hear your voice, call my name
I'll be waiting, waiting for you
When I hear your name, Lord, my heart burns with passion
I feel your love inside me
And until you call me, I'll be patiently waiting
Waiting for you
Oh, I'm waiting for you till you take me away
Where I'll be made faithful
I'll stay awake until I see your face
Hear your voice call my name
I'll be waiting, waiting for you
Oh, where I live and I'll be
Cause I know you promised the truth
And until you call me to you
I'll be waiting, oh, I'll be waiting
Waiting, ain't you out here waiting, waiting for you
